questions: Did you suffer a blunt force injury or traumatic impact to your head?
Have you had any new headaches, vision changes, or weakness in your limbs after your injury?
Did you lose consciousness when the injury occurred?
Have you had any surgery recently?
Did you have any symptoms like severe neck pain, headache, or dizziness that led you to come to the hospital?
Is your head bandage covering a surgical wound or drain site?
Do you remember how you arrived at the hospital today?
Have you had any falls or felt unsteady on your feet recently?
Have you noticed any fluid drainage from your nose or ears?
Were you feeling confused or disoriented before you came in?
Do you have any memory of the last few hours or days before coming to the hospital?
Has anyone told you that you had a seizure or that you were acting strangely?
Have you been taking any blood thinners like warfarin or aspirin?
Do you drink alcohol regularly?
The person who came to visit you - is that your partner or family member?
Are you safe at home? Has anyone hurt you recently?
Did someone put the bandage on your head for you?
Do you have a fever or chills?
Has your neck felt stiff or painful?
Have you had any nausea or vomiting recently?
Do you feel confused or like your thinking isn't clear?
How old are you?
Where do you live - with parents, on your own, or somewhere else?
Can you tell me what day of the week it is?
